# OSI network PDU (`osi`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [CLNP / ES-IS (P2)](../../protocols/clnp.md), [OSI encapsulation (P2)](../../protocols/osi.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`llc`](llc.md) | First 8 bits of the payload when `dsap` = 254 (0xfe) | (any other value) |
| [`ppp`](ppp.md) | First 8 bits of the payload when `protocol` = 35 (0x0023) | (any other value) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nlpid` | `enum(8)` | `131` (isis) |   | Network layer protocol identifier (ISO/IEC TR 9577): 0x81 CLNP, 0x82 ES-IS, 0x83 IS-IS. |
| `data` | `bytes` — rest of the PDU | `""` |   | Rest of the OSI PDU after the NLPID (opaque octets). |

### `nlpid`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | `null` |
| 129 (0x81) | `clnp` |
| 130 (0x82) | `esis` |
| 131 (0x83) | `isis` |
| 142 (0x8e) | `ipv6` |
| 204 (0xcc) | `ipv4` |
